reason: A DSH web settings panel for managing MCP server and Skill visibility, activation, persistence, and optional on-demand MCP mediation; the README provides clear evidence for these capabilities.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 设置页查看并启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill，并可选按需管理 MCP 工具调用的管理面板。
summaries.en: A DSH settings panel for viewing and toggling MCP servers and Skills, with optional on-demand management of MCP tool calls.

capabilities: Provides a settings panel for listing and toggling MCP servers and skills
Changes MCP loader state and skill invocation metadata
Optionally enables AI-mediated MCP discovery and tool execution
Exposes local HTTP endpoints for state, configuration, toggles, and diagnostics
Persists management state and catalog snapshots to local files
